environment.topology: one control-plane and three worker nodes; three gateway replicas; singleton SQL, Redis, collector and backend fixtures
environment.traffic: one external Docker client and one source IP; TLS to Traefik, mTLS/signed context to the backend; telemetry enabled
environment.nativeLogin: password only, no MFA; correct password; fresh native session per operation
environment.oauth: first-party public PKCE S256 client: authorize, code exchange and refresh
environment.windows: CPU samples use metrics-server averaging windows; SQL gauges sampled at 1s and read from the final 25s; adjacent stages can overlap in these samples

outage.scope: One identity router and one Traefik instance
